runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated Alpha 1 Skills and implementer TOML committed in a disposable source repository; worktrees feature enabled; top-level managed worktree; project rules ignored; base user configuration loaded because this CLI rejects --worktree with --ignore-user-config.
runtime.permissionProfile: workspace-write sandbox with approval policy never inside the managed worktree

assertions.evidence: The root read and applied the generated bug-fix Skill.
Before spawning the writer, the root captured exit 1 with actual true and expected false from the exact test command.
The root identified the off-by-one upper bound before delegation.
Exactly one bounded writer was started and collected; no replacement or retry worker was created.
The root made no implementation edit while the worker wrote. The child shared the top-level managed worktree, while the original source checkout remained clean.
The root collected the worker's one-line correction and passing focused-test report before inspecting state.
The root ran git status, git diff, and git diff --check after collection; an outer check independently confirmed the one-line diff.
The root reran the original command; exit 0 reported two passes and zero failures.
Only project/lib/port.mjs changed in the managed worktree and the source checkout remained clean.

limitations: The writer child shared the root's managed worktree; Codex CLI did not provide a separate per-child worktree on this surface.
The generated custom role was not selectable, so the workflow used its declared inline bounded-implementer fallback.
The run loaded base user configuration and emitted unrelated MCP authentication warnings because Codex CLI 0.155.1 rejects --worktree with --ignore-user-config.
